The mismatch is in the door labels. The import file calls the doors E1 and E2, but Marrow Agrisupply's booking sheet calls them 01 and 02. You flagged this in #central-team on June 9. The point was to sort it out before anyone reimports, so it doesn't create duplicate doors.

That thread is the only place I found it. I don't see a later update on whether the labels were reconciled, so check the ticket before the call.
